title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12755__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12755__PART_1_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12755__PART_1_). This Indian Standard (Part 1 ), which is identical with ISO 1073/1 :1976 Alphanumeric character sets for optical recognition — Part 1 : Character set OCR-A — Shapes and dimensions of the printed image', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the the Computers, Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee ( LTDC 24 ) and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards, attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the wo^ds 'International Standard' appear referring to the standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard', b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
